items.text: I applaud the participants of today's 54th Annual Walk for Hunger for the work you do to end hunger in Massachusetts. I look forward to continuing to partner with @projectbread to fight for stronger federal nutrition programs & to end food insecurity in the U.S. once and for all.

As climate disasters become more frequent, climate anxiety intensifies the already dire mental health crisis. I'm introducing the Community Mental Wellness and Resilience Act to empower communities to face these overlapping health crises. https://t.co/TJ8OvTdLyA

I applaud these workers who are exercising their right to organize, a fundamental exercise in democracy. I’m proud of their commitment not to agonize, but to organize. I recognize their effort to unionize and look forward to engaging with ⁦them.⁩ https://t.co/Ns9o5alfDi

Food is essential to life, and nutrition is a fundamental pillar of treatment for people with critical and chronic illnesses. It was so great to visit @communityserv in Boston today as they do important work to address food security and improve patient outcomes through nutrition. https://t.co/7tuaD1TKny

This Mental Health Awareness Month, we must recognize the climate crisis's impacts— both visible and invisible—on our frontline communities. That's why @RepPaulTonko, @RepFitzpatrick, and I are reintroducing the Community Mental Wellness and Resilience Act to defeat these crises.

Americans should be able to exercise their right to strike without fear. Today’s ruling unacceptably undermines longstanding protections for workers by threatening to weaken or chill future strikes, a foundational tool in the fight for economic justice for working people.

Unionizing is a fundamental exercise in democracy, and it is time the Senate allow its workers to legally form unions. I am proud to represent the first Senate office to voluntarily recognize these dedicated workers in their effort to unionize. Here's to more. https://t.co/wObTTDuso1

From learning about tribal history with Mother Bear, to hearing about the First Light Oyster Farm’s important work to cultivate shellfish, exercise their aboriginal rights, and clean Popponesset Bay—I had a wonderful time meeting with members of the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe today. https://t.co/rgzJURgVlC

Every day, fishermen face demanding, dangerous conditions that wear down their physical and mental health—all while working to put food on American tables. The FISH Wellness Act will help fishing families get the resources they need to stay safe and healthy. https://t.co/UdZxipRl2m

Climate compounds our mental health crisis, but community and public health can prevent the invisible scars. This Mental Health Awareness Month, it's time to pass my Community Mental Wellness & Resilience Act.

Corporate greed and fearmongering is keeping life-saving addiction medication away from the patients. It's time to stop putting profits over public health and pass my Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act.

I am sending strength and love to my friend, Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee, in the wake of this news. My prayers are with you as you enter treatment and I look forward to our continued work together.

Airlines need to get their act together. It’s ridiculous that, after the recent—and preventable—outage, passengers have been left without answers or solutions. Airlines need to follow the law and uphold their commitments to flyers. https://t.co/nJVHiXiydR
We are in an opioid overdose crisis. Easing access to methadone medication can save lives. We must pass my Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act. https://t.co/FGUXDbDudb

Today we celebrated the groundbreaking of the Springfield Water and Sewer Commission Water Treatment Plant. I was proud to secure $4.6 million in federal funding & vote for federal loans to make sure the people of Springfield have access to clean drinking water. https://t.co/RVbtxo0Oa8

This study makes clear what we already know—methadone is a life-saving treatment for opioid use disorder and we need to make it more accessible by passing the Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act. https://t.co/ztbrqng8pm

We won't solve the opioid epidemic until we start treating methadone like the life-saving medication it is. It's time to pass my and @SenRandPaul Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act. https://t.co/CdnqGxE4Ip

Methadone saves lives. But outdated rules make it harder for people to stay in recovery while helping rich investors make more money. We must fix this by passing my Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act. https://t.co/r32z59IGLm

Hospitals, health centers, doctors, pharmacists, and patients across the country are fighting for my Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act (MOTAA) because they know it’ll save lives. Congress must pass MOTAA to help put a stop to the overdose epidemic. https://t.co/9KJqwfRvko
Acadia is profiting off the opioid epidemic and fighting my bill to expand access to lifesaving methadone treatment. Their corporate greed should have no place in health care. https://t.co/DsbBnNFAM2

.@SenatorBraun and I are concerned that private-equity-backed opioid treatment programs seeking to maintain their monopoly on methadone have kept this lifesaving medication from patients in need—all to boost their bottom line. It's unacceptable, and we're demanding answers. https://t.co/xEMBb9lrC1

Back in March, @SenatorBraun and I wrote to methadone clinics asking about private equity's role in their programs, but they failed to address our questions. We won't stop pushing for answers. We can't let private equity stand in the way of addiction treatment. https://t.co/srdkf5KnGc

I applaud PBS for continuing to lead the way in creating children’s programming like Carl the Collector that is accessible and inclusive, especially for kids with disabilities. This educational programming demonstrates the unique value of public media. https://t.co/QahctdvUmJ

Who wins by closing Head Start offices?

Who wins by cutting money for Alzheimer’s research and addiction treatment?

Who wins by halting work on food safety and HIV prevention?

Donald Trump and Elon Musk.
https://t.co/VBMT2Q8zKm

The House passed the SAVE Act, which will disenfranchise millions of voters, including women who change their last names after marriage. We need to be making it easier, not harder, for Americans to exercise their right to vote.
